_comment: Bicycles and the National Zoological Park (OWNER-DECISIONS 278, 291(4)). src/routemaker/zoo.py reads this file and national-zoo.geojson beside it; fixtures/zoo/README.md has the sources.
decision: 291(4): close the Zoo polygon to riding except the Rock Creek Trail edge pieces, the public streets, and a destination-only spur from the Harvard Street NW entrance to the bike racks. Nothing routes through the Zoo. A route to the Zoo ends at the racks.

spur.entrance: Harvard Street NW at Adams Mill Road NW: the Zoo's Harvard Street entrance, the gate (OSM node 642824625) and ticket checkpoint (node 11565077439) at the end of Harvard Street

racks.note: On the footway 183192886, 190 m by the spur from the entrance gate. The other bicycle parking inside the Zoo (node 10016451829, a rack of 11 at Olmsted Walk, 300 m in; node 497415790, a rack of 11 by the Connecticut Avenue entrance) is farther in and is not used.

ways.what: the entrance road from Harvard Street to the gate, unclassified, motor_vehicle=no
a crossing footway at the gate
sidewalk by the entrance plaza to the ticket checkpoint
the footway bridge from the checkpoint into the Zoo, 107 m
the footway on to the racks, 62 m
the footway the racks stand on, 40 m
